The behavior technician implemented Discrete Trial Training during the session. The behavior technician utilized a three-item array for receptive identification. The behavior technician utilized full physical prompting at the outset of the session. The behavior technician faded prompting to independent responding across the session. The client demonstrated the ability to respond independently on two opportunities. The behavior technician delivered reinforcement contingent on independent responding. The client engaged in the activity of matching for the remainder of the session. The behavior technician utilized errorless learning procedures throughout.
